description: Source code for a tokenizer class used in parsing text, including comment skipping, tokenization, and handling of string and comment tokens.

classes.name: tokenizer
classes.description: A class for tokenizing input streams, handling comments, strings, and token types.

methods.name: tokenizer
methods.description: Constructor initializing tokenizer with input stream and setting initial line number.

methods.name: skip_comment
methods.description: Skips comments and processes tokenizer directives like textdomain and line number.

methods.name: next_token
methods.description: Retrieves the next token from the input stream, handling different token types.

methods.name: next_char
methods.description: Advances to the next character in the input stream, updating line number on newlines.

methods.name: peek_char
methods.description: Returns the next character without consuming it.

methods.name: is_space
methods.description: Checks if a character is a space or tab.

methods.name: is_alnum
methods.description: Checks if a character is alphanumeric or underscore.

methods.name: get_line
methods.description: Returns a string with the current line number and filename.
